title: [Bug] Anthropic API: Unexpected Weekly Token Limit Depletion
body:
**Bug Description**
Weekly limit reaching 100 with perhaps 1/50th amount of normal usage (I don't vibe code).

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: iTerm.app
- Version: 2.0.5
- Feedback ID: 542b6e13-e5d8-4c25-8efe-71bbf9dfa4c1

top_comments.author: guidedways
top_comments.body:
The irony is that I stopped using Claude Code and switched to Codex, just used Claude earlier today for basic things like 'run these unit tests and make sure they all pass' and that's it. Repeatedly ran these on and off all day - claude code was made to do no real development work.

Shocking to see I'm around 80% through a weekly limit within a few hours of zero actual work.

top_comments.author: non-stop-dev
top_comments.body:
Weekly limits went wild. It is absolutely irrational. Even the pricing structure doesn’t match with usage limits. 20x plan users are facing same issue… so what’s the solution? Create 4 accounts and pay separately 200$ x 4 times to be able to use Claude Code across the entire week? Insane. 

This looks like the ration books for food they gave out in the Soviet Union and Cuba 🤌🏻.

“Sr you have to pay this bunch of money to be able to eat breadcrumbs”… that’s how this usage limit sounds
